goal: I want more creators signing up this month.

steps.title: A shorter sign-up form
steps.why: Sign-up asks for 9 fields before a creator sees any deal, including GST, which most students don't have, and bank details. Doubtful creators also take a request for bank details as a sign of a scam. If they can sign up with just name, phone, email and Instagram, far more of them will finish on a pho
steps.seen: signup.html: 9 required inputs (name as on PAN, email, phone, Instagram, PAN, GST, bank account, IFSC, full postal address); the phone input has no type. terms.html: 'PAN is required before the first payout', so PAN is not needed at sign-up.
steps.build: In signup.html, keep only four required fields: name (relabel it 'Your name'), phone (type="tel", inputmode="numeric", autocomplete="tel"), email (type="email", autocomplete="email") and Instagram handle (placeholder '@yourhandle'). Remove the pan, gst, account, ifsc and address inputs. Change the h1 to 'Join as a creator' and the button to 'Sign up free'. Under the button, add one short line: 'We'll ask for PAN and bank details only when you get your first payout.' Keep form action="dashboard.html". In test_pages.py, keep the existing tests and add test_signup_is_short: assert signup.html contains no name="gst", name="pan", name="account", name="ifsc" or name="address", and has at most 4 'required' attributes.
steps.decide: Do any creators ever need to give a GST number, or can we stop asking for it?
options: Ask only at first payout if they earn above a limit
Keep asking, but make it optional

steps.title: A home page that invites creators
steps.why: The home page uses vague words ('Sunny Shop is a platform... deliver value'), speaks only to brands, and puts creator sign-up in tiny footer text. A creator arriving from Instagram can't tell they can earn here, or how. Real named deals and the 7-day payment promise are what make a doubtful creator
steps.seen: index.html: the headline is 'Welcome to Sunny Shop', the only call to action is 'Contact sales' for brands, and 'Creator sign-up' is a footer link. deals.html shows real paid deals (Chai Co: 2 reels, ₹3,000; Kurta House: 1 post, ₹1,500; FitBottle: 3 stories, ₹2,000) that the home page never mentions
steps.build: In index.html, replace the first part of <main> (the h1 and the two vague paragraphs) with a creator-first top block. Add an h1 'Get paid by Indian brands for your Instagram posts' and a short line 'Free to join. Pick the deals you like. Paid within 7 days of approval.' Add a large full-width link to signup.html with class="cta" reading 'Sign up as a creator'. Add a short list of the three example deals copied from deals.html, each with brand, task and ₹ amount. Add the earnings line only if the owner chooses it in the question below. Move the About and Brands sections below this block and keep the footer links. In style.css, add a .cta class (display:block, text-align:center, padding 14px, background #f59e0b, color #fff, border-radius 6px, font-size 18px, text-decoration none). In test_pages.py, add test_home_has_creator_cta: index.html contains 'href="signup.html"' with class="cta" and contains '₹'.
steps.decide: May the home page tell creators what new creators earn? Real example deals are more believable to cautious creators than a monthly figure.
options: Also show 'New creators earn about ₹8,000 a month'

steps.title: Make the ₹500 invite easy to find and share
steps.why: Each creator gets ₹500 for bringing in another creator, but no page links to the invite page. A new creator who signs up lands on a dashboard that says only 'No data.', and the reward itself is in grey 12px text 400px down the page. A friend's WhatsApp message is the most likely way to win over doub
steps.seen: dashboard.html: just the heading 'Dashboard' and 'No data.', with no links. No page links to invite.html (index.html's footer links only to terms and sign-up). invite.html: heading 'Invite', body 'You can invite other creators.', and the reward line 'when an invited creator finishes their first deal
steps.build: In dashboard.html, replace 'No data.' with a short welcome: 'You're in! Here's what to do next.' Below it, add two full-width links with class="cta": 'See open deals' to deals.html and 'Invite a friend, you both get ₹500' to invite.html. In invite.html, change the h1 to 'Invite a friend, you both get ₹500'. Move the reward sentence directly under the h1 as normal-size dark text, keeping its wording exactly so test_invite_reward_is_500 still passes, and remove the inline margin-top:400px, font-size and colour styles. Rename the button to 'Copy my invite link' and place it after the reward line. Below it, add a WhatsApp share link <a class="cta" href="https://wa.me/?text=..."> with a URL-encoded message: 'Join Sunny Shop and get paid by brands for Instagram posts. We both get ₹500 after your first deal: [link]'. In test_pages.py, add test_invite_reachable_and_visible: dashboard.html contains 'href="invite.html"' and 'href="deals.html"' and does not contain 'No data.'; invite.html does not contain 'margin-top:400px', has '₹500' inside the <h1>, and contains 'wa.me'.

answers: Ask only at first payout if they earn above a limit
Also show 'New creators earn about ₹8,000 a month'
